tijori.business_description: Karamtara Engineering Ltd., founded in 1996, is an integrated manufacturer serving renewable energy and power transmission sectors. Its portfolio includes solar mounting structures, tracker components, wind towers, transmission towers, fasteners and OHTL fittings, with exports to 50+ countries.
